description:
Adds an optional Wispr Flow button to Gboard's toolbar menu. Dictation uses Gboard's native voice controls and keeps recording while the keyboard is hidden. Reopen Gboard in a text field to cancel or insert the transcript.

Use the included Wispr Flow keyboard bridge 0.3.1 with LSPosed scoped to Wispr Flow 2.8.5 or 2.8.7. Requires Android 14 or newer. Refresh the source in Morphe and select Wispr Flow when patching Gboard 18.5.4.993608717-release-arm64-v8a.

Includes DuckDuckGo Email Protection and upstream v4.3.0 with Frosted Glass fixes.
